Programs & ages

The studio accepts students ages 3 to 18.

Ballet classes are available for ages 3 to 18.

Jazz classes are available for ages 6 to 18.

Hip-hop classes are available for ages 6 to 18.

Contemporary classes are available for ages 8 to 18.

Beginner classes do not require previous dance experience.

Advanced classes require instructor approval.

Students may enroll in more than one dance style.

All programs are open to boys and girls.

Schedule

The studio is open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Saturday classes are available from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

The studio is closed on Sundays.

Each regular dance class lasts 60 minutes.

Ballet classes are held every Monday and Wednesday from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

Jazz classes are held every Friday from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

Hip-hop classes are held every Tuesday and Thursday from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

Contemporary classes are held every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Pricing

Ballet classes cost $200 per month.

Jazz classes cost $180 per month.

Hip-hop classes cost $150 per month.

Contemporary classes cost $190 per month.

Tuition is due on the first day of each month.

Dance uniforms and shoes are not included in tuition.

Recital costumes are charged separately at $100 per student.

Payments can be made by credit card or bank transfer.

Dress code

Ballet students must wear a leotard, tights, and ballet shoes.

Jazz students must wear fitted dancewear and jazz shoes.
